title: VTC Events — Series — Split — payload
description: Change a series from one occurrence onward: the series ends before it and a linked continuation starts with it, carrying its registrations. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

from.description: The first occurrence the change applies to, by its original start.

when.description: The continuation's time; absent keeps the series' time of day and duration from `from`.

recurrence.description: The continuation's rule; absent continues the series' rule.

reason.description: Why, for the audit record. Plain text.

Response.title: VTC Events — Series — Split — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/series/split/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/series/split/0.1#response.

ended.description: The series as it now stands, ending before `from`.
